title: Diagnose what broke
description: Map the live path — services, traffic, and the symptom — before changing anything. Logs and metrics beat the architecture diagram.

title: Design the fix in code
description: Codify the change so it rebuilds from scratch: networking, IAM, and the modules the next engineer can read.

title: Automate the delivery
description: Wrap it in a pipeline anyone can re-run: cached builds, containers, gated environments, and a rollback that is not a hallway conversation.

title: Watch, harden, iterate
description: Page on symptoms, not noise. Tighten cost, security, and recovery time on every cycle.
